name: troubleshoot_failed_run_double_iri
why: A playbook that FAILED on the box, with its real run history replayed
(recorded from a live 8.0 appliance by scripts/record_runs.py). The
defect is invisible to static checks -- verify_playbook passes it clean --
and only the run says what happened: 'Read Full Alert' 404s on
that is already a full IRI. A right answer reads the run, names that
step, and delivers a fix that drops the prefix. A guess that never
looks at the run cannot see the doubled path.
behaves: the iri reads the record's @id and the doubled prefix is gone
from it; the steps are kept (no_step_loss). reads: the turn consulted
the recorded run history, not only the YAML.

steps.user: This playbook fails every time I run it. Work out why and fix it.

assertions.note: the request still reads the found alert's @id
the doubled prefix is gone -- @id is already a full IRI
the read is still there -- not deleted to silence it
iri is the full IRI as-is -- make_cyops_request requests exactly that path, so a bare uuid cut out of @id 404s too
